note: Sonic Mania's values, doubled because Pizza Tower's world is drawn at about twice Mania's scale.

rows.name: wall_run_speed
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: the running speed that starts a wall run without the boost button

rows.name: feet_offset
rows.mania_value: drawing only

rows.name: ball_offset
rows.mania_value: drawing only

rows.name: sfx_mix
rows.mania_value: sound: level of Mania's sounds next to Pizza Tower's own, from the mixer meter at full volume: hurt 1.0, kill 0.54, jump 0.45 of Mania's level

rows.name: sfx_gain_at_17
rows.mania_value: sound: what Pizza Tower's slider at 17% does to its own sound effects, from the mixer meter (hurt 0.018 of 0.36)

rows.name: sfx_gain_at_50
rows.mania_value: sound: what Pizza Tower's slider at 50% does to its own sound effects, from the mixer meter (hurt 0.062 of 0.36)

rows.name: door_walk_ticks
rows.mania_value: door animation, built from Mania's frames: Mania has no doors

rows.name: door_fade_start
rows.mania_value: door animation, built from Mania's frames: Mania has no doors

rows.name: door_fade_ticks
rows.mania_value: door animation, built from Mania's frames: Mania has no doors

rows.name: door_scale_min
rows.mania_value: door animation, built from Mania's frames: Mania has no doors

rows.name: gate_anim_rate
rows.mania_value: a level gate holds the screen longer than a door's fade, so the same animation plays slower

rows.name: rank_zoom_ms
rows.mania_value: how long Sonic takes to zoom up on the results screen

rows.name: rank_scale
rows.mania_value: Sonic's size at the end of the zoom

rows.name: rank_x
rows.mania_value: where he ends up, in the 960 by 540 screen

rows.name: rank_y
rows.mania_value: where he ends up, in the 960 by 540 screen

rows.name: rank_p_y
rows.mania_value: on the P rank he stands on the stage, centre screen

rows.name: menu_scale
rows.mania_value: Sonic's size on the file select

rows.name: menu_y
rows.mania_value: how far below the game's Peppino spot he stands, on the floor by the stool

rows.name: fly_ticks
rows.mania_value: Tails tires after 8 seconds, as in Mania

rows.name: fly_lift
rows.mania_value: each tap of jump lifts him, doubled

rows.name: fly_up
rows.mania_value: fastest he rises, doubled

rows.name: fly_fall
rows.mania_value: how gently he sinks, doubled

rows.name: fly_down
rows.mania_value: fastest he sinks while flying, doubled

rows.name: glide_start
rows.mania_value: Knuckles's glide starts at 4, doubled

rows.name: glide_top
rows.mania_value: and speeds up to 12, doubled

rows.name: glide_acc
rows.mania_value: how fast the glide gains speed, doubled

rows.name: glide_fall
rows.mania_value: how fast the glide sinks, doubled

rows.name: climb_speed
rows.mania_value: climbing speed, doubled

rows.name: boost_start
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: Pizza Tower's Mach Run starts at this speed the moment the button is held

rows.name: boost_acc
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: speed gained per tick while boosting, so a short run-up is enough

rows.name: boost_top
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: top speed while boosting, Mach 3's range

rows.name: boost_break
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: from this boosting speed Sonic breaks blocks and defeats enemies by running into them

rows.name: wall_run_up
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: the slowest a wall run climbs, so short run-ups still clear tall walls

rows.name: dash_speed
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: Pizza Tower's Grab Dash starting speed

rows.name: land_buffer
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: a jump pressed this many ticks before landing still happens

rows.name: coyote
rows.mania_value: not in Mania: a jump pressed this many ticks after running off a ledge still happens
